caption:
Offered a store card at checkout? 🛍️

Say: "No thanks."

A discount today isn't always worth a new hard inquiry and another account to manage. Check your own situation first.

Have you ever signed up at the register?
first_comment: Did you ever sign up at checkout and regret it? 👇
sources: pattern: if X happens, say this

card.headline: Card offer at checkout? Say: "No thanks."
card.sub: A discount isn't always worth a new account.
